visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs, wearing a blue t-shirt, is shown in a small window at the top of the frame. She is holding a smartphone horizontally with both hands, focusing intensely on the screen. Below her, the larger part of the screen displays a screen recording of a mobile MOBA game (Arena of Valor). The game scene is chaotic, showing multiple character avatars with health bars engaged in a team fight near a base structure. Various skill icons and map indicators flash rapidly. (2) The visual focus shifts as the game interface shows a base structure exploding. The woman in the top window reacts with high energy, raising both arms in the air, laughing with an open mouth and squinted eyes, expressing intense joy and excitement. Brightly colored variety text and comic-style emphasis lines appear around her window. (3) The woman lowers her arms and leans closer to the camera, talking directly to the lens while still holding her phone. She smiles broadly, looking back and forth between her phone and the camera, set against a background featuring a red mesh ergonomic office chair and a plain white wall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo, driving electronic game music. A female voice speaks rapidly with high pitch and excitement, accompanied by the percussive sounds of game skill activations and impact hits. (2) A sudden, high-pitched digital car horn sound effect triggers a shift; the music sustains its energy as the speaker's vocal arousal increases, punctuated by sharp laughter and high-frequency exclamations. (3) A loud, synthesized cheering and applause sound effect explodes in the mix, signifying a major event. The speaker screams with joy, her pitch reaching a peak of intensity. (4) The music transitions to a lighter, more melodic acoustic-style synthesizer track. The female voice drops to a normal conversational volume and pitch, speaking clearly with a friendly and satisfied tone to conclude the segment.
